Sub Paint(ByVal target As Font, Optional ByVal index As Long = wdAuto)
  target.ColorIndex = index
End Sub
Sub Main()
  Dim target As Font
  Set target = ThisDocument.Sections(2).Footers(wdHeaderFooterEvenPages).Range.Paragraphs(3).Range.Font
  Paint index:=wdBlue, target:=target
  If IsNull(StrComp(Null, "x")) Then
    target.Color = wdColorAutomatic
  End If
End Sub

provenance.note: Named ByVal helper arguments retain the explicit footer identity; handled Null results can choose a later automatic foreground write. Expected plans and diagnostic token positions are independently authored; no installed Office host was executed.
